description: This Python source file implements a transformation class for Azure Document Intelligence OCR, including request/response handling, environment validation, and async polling logic. It converts between Mistral OCR format and Azure API v4.0, supporting multiple models and handling async operation polling.

classes.name: AzureDocumentIntelligenceOCRConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure Document Intelligence OCR, providing environment validation, URL construction, request transformation, and response parsing with support for async polling.

methods.description: Validates API key and endpoint environment variables, constructs request headers.

methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for Azure DI analyze endpoint based on model and base URL.

methods.description: Extracts base64 content from a data URI string.

methods.description: Converts Azure DI page dimensions from inches to pixels using configured DPI.

methods.description: Synchronously polls the operation URL until completion or timeout.
